{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-mo-f","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"2a6f482a6f6a39f3407ccd3cf7dba44f3a557457cbe3127faa2951b88928a54c","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-mo-class-f:lineage:6","source_registry_sha256":"f128002157e581eb7004b9370c8cfbafd7b29a1596262980704fbda0a45932f5","source_liveness_sha256":"fdf72d02e75b9589fee5aaf5b83ec9705ff03586f574464e3553a827f9b698d8"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"GDL day counts, supervisor ages, credential terms and optional license notations","heading":"C2 — Confusable pairs and continuation facts: day counts, supervisor ages, credential terms, renewals and optional notations","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Confusable pairs and continuation facts: day counts, supervisor ages, credential terms, renewals and optional notations
Confusable pairs among the GDL day counts, supervisor ages and credential terms, plus continuation facts on renewals and the optional notations that complete part C; each block ties to one guide page, and hint metadata sits only in the trailing line of a block.

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A07
The intermediate step counts its six months as 182 days, beginning the day after the permit is issued. [A07]
Why it matters: group GDL day counts; confusable with the renewal-lapse day count; difficulty high.
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A02
For a license that has lapsed, the guide counts six months as 184 days before the written and driving tests come back. [A02]
Why it matters: group GDL day counts; confusable with the permit holding period; difficulty high.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A06
Under 16, a front-seat companion who is not one of the listed relatives, a guardian or a qualified instructor must be at least 25, licensed three years or more and hold written parent permission, while from 16 any licensed driver aged 21 or older qualifies. [A06]
Why it matters: group supervision; confusable under-sixteen versus sixteen-plus companions; difficulty medium.
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A06
If the parent, stepparent, grandparent or guardian is physically disabled, he or she may name up to two people to give the permit holder behind-the-wheel instruction. [A06]
Why it matters: group supervision; continuation of the companion rules.
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A07
Both intermediate passenger limits count only riders younger than 19 who are outside the driver's immediate family. [A07]
Why it matters: group intermediate limits; prereq passenger limits in C; difficulty medium.
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A07
The intermediate passenger limits may not apply while the license holder is doing agricultural work. [A07]
Why it matters: group intermediate limits; exception; difficulty medium.
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A07
The intermediate license is valid for up to 2 years, depending on document verification status. [A07]
Why it matters: group credential terms; confusable permit versus intermediate versus full terms.
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A08
The full under-21 license is valid for up to 3 years, depending on document verification status. [A08]
Why it matters: group credential terms; confusable with the intermediate term.
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A08
For the full under-21 license, both alcohol-related offenses and traffic convictions are checked over the last 12 months, and the privilege must not be suspended, revoked or denied when you apply. [A08]
Why it matters: group GDL eligibility; confusable with the intermediate look-back windows; difficulty high.
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A08
The guide warns that almost 50 percent of test-takers fail the written exam on the first try, so studying the guide first improves your odds. [A08]
Why it matters: group exam readiness; difficulty low.
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A08
A driver upgrading a license takes the same document set to the Highway Patrol examination site when sitting the written, vision, road sign or driving tests. [A08]
Why it matters: group documents; continuation of the checklist.
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R12 | anchor: A01
Endorsements beyond school bus and motorcycle are available only to holders of a commercial driver license or commercial learner's permit. [A01]
Why it matters: group endorsements; scope note; difficulty low.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec02-R13 | anchor: A01
After moving, you can update the address that renewal reminders go to at a local license office or online. [A01]
Why it matters: group renewals; prereq renewal reminder rule.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec02-R14 | anchor: A02
When the driver license and vehicle registration renewal dates fall within six months of each other, both renewals may be handled in one visit. [A02]
Why it matters: group renewals; difficulty low.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R15 | anchor: A02
Members of the armed forces and their dependents may renew by mail using the Mail-In Driver License Application, Form 4317, with the required documents and fees. [A02]
Why it matters: group renewals; confusable mail renewal versus renewal without re-examination.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R16 | anchor: A03
Applicants who say yes to the donor registry are then asked about the optional donor symbol, and a donor sticker for the back of the card can be requested online later. [A03]
Why it matters: group donor choices; confusable registry versus symbol.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R17 | anchor: A03
The clerk must ask whether you want to give money to the organ donor fund or the blindness awareness fund. [A03]
Why it matters: group counter questions; difficulty low.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R18 | anchor: A04
A Missouri resident holding a current Boating Safety Education Card may add a boater safety indicator, which costs $1 extra the first time it is added. [A04]
Why it matters: group optional notations; dynamic fee.
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec02-R19 | anchor: A04
A permanent disability indicator goes on the back of the card only with a Physicians Statement (Form 5294), costs nothing extra and is never required by law. [A04]
Why it matters: group optional notations; confusable back-of-card versus front-of-card notations.
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec02-R20 | anchor: A04
A veteran may have VETERAN printed on the front of the card by showing an accepted discharge document, such as a DD Form 214 showing honorable or general under honorable conditions, at no extra cost. [A04]
Why it matters: group optional notations; difficulty low.
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec02-R21 | anchor: A05
A medical alert notation for listed conditions such as diabetes, epilepsy or autism can go on the front of the card with a signed Form 5839, at no extra cost and never by legal requirement. [A05]
Why it matters: group optional notations; confusable with the disability indicator.
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-R22 | anchor: A05
The federal Driver's Privacy Protection Act requires states to close personal information in motor vehicle and license records unless state law directs otherwise. [A05]
Why it matters: group records privacy; difficulty medium.
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-R23 | anchor: A05
At the counter the clerk asks whether you are registered to vote at your current address and can generate updated voter registration for your signature. [A05]
Why it matters: group counter questions; difficulty low.
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-R24 | anchor: A05
Male applicants aged 18 to 26 may register with the Selective Service when they apply for a license or permit. [A05]
Why it matters: group counter questions; difficulty low.
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0016]
